title: Area 6 · Goblin den

sourceRecords.title: Area 6 · Yeemik and Sildar
read: A cooking fire lights an uneven cavern. Goblins look up from their meal. On a higher ledge, a battered human man is held upright by one of them. He can barely stand.
One goblin raises a hand for the others to hold. “You want the human? Then we have something to discuss.”

brief: Cragmaw goblin den, natural cave divided by TEN-foot escarpment, steep natural stairs between lower NORTH area and upper SOUTH ledge. Small cooking fire on lower floor, smoke haze, poorly cured hides and rough sleeping mats. Prepared initial encounter: FIVE ordinary goblins around lower fire, ONE goblin leader Yeemik above with bound older human Sildar on upper ledge, no armor or weapon on captive. No guard execution, deep bottomless cliff or presumed completed rescue. Original encounter illustration is historical after party rescued him, not current state.
